_comment: PROPOSED BASELINE — ratify before any launch (see docs/TOKEN_ROADMAP.md §13). Devnet/draft.
name: RUNECLAW Token
_metadataUri_comment: MUTABLE — must be replaced before any real mint. This is a branch URL, so its bytes can change after the URI is permanently baked into the mint and the update authority is renounced. Replace with an Arweave/IPFS URI, or pin the full 40-char commit SHA in place of 'main'. The same applies to the image URL inside rclaw-metadata.json. create_token.mjs refuses to run against a branch URL unless acknowledgeMutableMetadataUri is true.
_acknowledgeMutableMetadataUri_comment: true is correct ONLY for throwaway devnet runs. Set to false — and supply an immutable metadataUri — before any launch.
_authorities_comment: All four must be true for a launch. The first two fix the SUPPLY; the last two fix the token's IDENTITY — without them the payer keeps permanent power to rewrite name/symbol/uri or redirect where wallets look for metadata. verify_token.mjs refuses to run unless the first two are true, and checks all four on-chain.
